== Acquisition ==
This skill can be temporarily acquired by [[Primary profession|primary]] [[Ranger]]s by talking to [[Kuunavang]] in [[Raisu Palace]], [[Imperial Sanctum]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aegis}}
* {{skill icon|Shield Guardian}}

== Notes ==
* The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only be recharged when gaining a [[Morale Boost]].
* Despite the name, this is not a [[stance]].
{{anomaly|Though it is not listed in the skill description, this skill—like all other celestial skills—has an activation time of 1.}}
{{bug|Using this skill while it is still active does not reset the [[duration]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] shows a [[Tyria]]n warrior wearing [[Warrior Elite Dragon armor|Elite Dragon armor]].
